regions.today: Today will be mostly dry with a few sunny spells at first and the chance of isolated showers. Cloud will thicken from the west later this morning and afternoon with isolated drizzle patches in the midlands this evening. Highest temperatures of 17 to 19 degrees in moderate southerly winds.
regions.tonight: Cloudy tonight with rain and drizzle spreading from the west early on. The rain will ease and turn patchier later. Lowest temperatures of 11 to 13 degrees in light to moderate southwesterly winds.
regions.tomorrow: Much of tomorrow will be dull with lingering drizzle near east and southeast coasts at first. Any drizzle will clear by afternoon with sunny spells slowly spreading from the northwest by evening. Highest temperatures of 13 to 16 degrees in a light to moderate southwest breeze.
regions.solar_uv: Low to moderate Thursday and Friday.
